title: What's new: Cross-environment Master Data Management (2026 release wave 2)

features.name: Cross-environment Master Data Synchronization
features.description: Subsidiaries in the same tenant but different environments can pull master data from headquarters using a built-in solution with no middleware or custom code required.
caveats: Picture size limited to 512 KB each
HQ must grant read permissions for each table
Only changes are synchronized, not full data every time

features.name: Entra ID-based Authorization
features.description: Access across environments is secured through Microsoft Entra ID with app registration and admin consent workflow.
caveats: App must be registered in the same tenant
Admin consent required in source environment

features.name: Read-only HQ Data Source
features.description: Headquarters company remains the read-only main source of data, controlling what data subsidiaries can access through permission sets.
caveats: HQ admin approval required for each subsidiary access
Read permissions must be configured per table

features.name: Delta Synchronization with Web Services
features.description: Only changes (deltas) are synchronized between environments using data services and web service technology, not full dataset transfers.
caveats: Automatic scheduling of synchronization jobs required

features.name: Secure Credential Storage
features.description: OAuth credentials for cross-environment access are stored securely in a wizard-based setup and cannot be read by users at any time.

features.name: Flexible App Registration Strategy
features.description: Customers can choose to register one app shared across multiple subsidiaries or register a separate app per subsidiary based on audit requirements.

features.name: Cross-environment Setup Wizard
features.description: Simplified wizard interface guides subsidiaries through entering headquarters environment name, company name, and OAuth credentials.

features.name: Picture and Attachment Propagation
features.description: Pictures and attachments travel along with synchronized master data records across environments.
caveats: Maximum file size: 512 KB per picture

features.name: Default Tables and Custom Permission Sets
features.description: A predefined set of default master data tables are synchronized by default; additional tables require creating custom permission sets with read permissions.
caveats: Custom tables require admin to create new permission sets

features.name: Automatic Synchronization Status Monitoring
features.description: Synchronization log shows modification status and changes; logs can be viewed per table through the same UI as single-environment synchronization.
